item.title: Pub 55: Lubbock's new place to be
item.description: Pub 55, a locally owned pub in Lubbock, is set to open on March 16, offering a relaxed atmosphere, cocktails, and a unique menu with familiar favorites and new twists.

item.title: Texas Tech men's basketball drops in rankings after BYU loss
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas-- The Texas Tech men's basketball team dropped six spots to No. 16 after concluding its regular season with a loss to BYU on Saturday, 82-76. item.title: Randall County Sheriff's Office investigating report of person driving off Palo Duro Canyon State Park
item.description: The Randall County Sheriff's Department responded to a call of an individual who had driven a vehicle off a cliff at Palo Duro Canyon.

item.title: Red Raider trio recognized with All-Big 12 awards
item.description: The Big 12 revealed its men's basketball awards for the 2026 season on Monday. Texas Tech had three of its players recognized by the conference for their exceptional performances this season.

item.title: From Show Ring to Life: Lessons learned in a Brownfield barn
item.description: As the steer shows wrapped up at the San Antonio Stock Show and Rodeo, families and students across Texas reflected on the months, and often years, of work that lead to just a few minutes in the show ring.

item.title: Bueno Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu starting a program for law enforcement agencies
item.description: The martial art skills of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is now being used as a tool for local law enforcement officers.

item.title: LPD urges safe driving for motorcycles and cars after weekend crashes
item.description: Over the weekend, there were two major crashes that resulted in death. Following these tragedies, the Lubbock Police Department urged drivers and motorcyclists to be cautious when on the road.

item.title: Most school voucher applicants already go to private schools, report says
item.description: More than 160,000 families have applied for Texas’ new “Education Freedom Accounts” program so far, according to the Comptroller.
